notes.title: "Break Robots VR" is compatible with Oculus. Don’t miss the 40% off sale!
notes.content:
We used Oculus quest 2 to check that "Break Robots VR" is compatible with Oculus. Let’s grab the Lunar New Year sale to buy this game with the 40% off price!

*The Lunar New Year sale will end on 4th Feb.
